parts.description: A collection of hollow pitchers and bottles with glazed ceramic bodies, clear and tinted glass vessels, and one transparent plastic bottle. The forms include handled pouring jugs, cylindrical bottles, a square glass flask with cork, and narrow-neck bottles in brown, blue, gray, cream, amber, green, and clear finishes.
